preconditions.expression: isinstance(reindeer_names, list) and all(isinstance(name, str) for name in reindeer_names)
preconditions.description: The input is a list of strings, where each string represents a reindeer's full name.
Each string in the list represents a full name consisting of exactly two words.

postconditions.description: The function returns a list of strings, each representing a reindeer's full name.
The list returned is sorted by the last names of the reindeer.

postconditions.expression: all(name1 <= name2 for name1, name2 in zip(reindeer_names, reindeer_names[1:]))
postconditions.description: The order of reindeer names is stable, meaning that if two reindeer have the same last name, their order relative to each other is preserved.
